description: Source code for HuggingFace storage handling in PyTorch distributed checkpointing, including classes for reading and writing safetensors in a distributed training context.

classes.name: HuggingFaceStorageWriter
classes.description: Handles writing checkpoint data in the huggingface safetensors format, supporting distributed and sharded checkpointing.

classes.name: HuggingFaceStorageReader
classes.description: Handles reading checkpoint data in the huggingface safetensors format, supporting parallel reading with threading.

methods.name: prepare_global_plan
methods.description: Prepares save plans with optional distributed and sharding metadata.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Writes checkpoint data according to the plan, handling sharding and metadata.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the write process, optionally consolidating sharded files and writing metadata.

methods.name: _split_by_storage_plan
methods.description: Splits write items into buckets based on storage plan indices.

methods.name: metadata_path
methods.description: Property returning the path to the metadata file.

methods.name: _process_read_request
methods.description: Processes a single read request, copying tensor slices into target tensors.

methods.name: _read_files_from_queue
methods.description: Worker function for parallel reading of files using threading.

methods.name: read_data
methods.description: Reads checkpoint data according to the plan, supporting parallel processing.

methods.name: read_metadata
methods.description: Reads and constructs metadata from safetensor files in the directory.
